title: 5.10 Can I Have...?
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Ask for food and drinks with Can I have ..., please?, and answer an offer with Yes, please. or No, thank you.
grammar_function: Can I have + food or drink + please? Do you want tea? Yes, please. / No, thank you.
prerequisite: 5.9 please and thank you; 5.6 want; 4.8 Do you...?; 5.2-5.3 food and drinks.
speaking_outcome: Ask Can I have ..., please? and accept or refuse an offer politely.
